# HelloChinese

> > HelloChinese is the #1 mobile app for learning Mandarin Chinese, featuring gamified lessons, speech recognition, and character writing practice across iOS and Android platforms.

HelloChinese offers comprehensive Mandarin Chinese courses with HSK-level curriculum, available in multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Thai, Vietnamese, and Russian. The app combines interactive lessons with voice recognition technology and handwriting practice to help learners master Chinese pronunciation, grammar, and characters.

## Key Topics

- Mandarin Chinese learning
- Mobile language app (iOS/Android)
- Gamified learning
- Speech recognition
- Character writing practice
- HSK test preparation
- Google Play & App Store
- APK downloads
- Pronunciation training
- Chinese grammar
- Hanzi writing
- Voice recognition technology
- Multi-language support
- Language education platform
